scientific_question: For the exact Q4_K FFN-down path, how much of the component latency and hardware inefficiency is caused by work decomposition, how much by execution representation/materialization, and is there a measurable interaction between the two?

level_1_constraints: Exactly one native subgroup of 32 lanes cooperates on one output row.
K is partitioned lane-stride 32 and reduced within that subgroup.
No logical Split-K64/128 search is part of this parent study.
No fusion with other semantic nodes.
Materialization occurs once before measured inference; zero per-token CPU model math.
No GPU-assisted materialization in this study.
Logical Q4_K value domain is preserved: q nibbles, FP16 d/dmin, integer scale/min semantics must reconstruct exactly.
Reorder and metadata duplication are allowed; exact layout must be frozen in a child implementation lock before any fresh performance execution.
B retains serial k=0..18943 accumulation order; materialization must not introduce additional K parallelism.

A.name: WORK_DECOMPOSITION
A.purpose: Isolate causal effect of work decomposition.

AB.name: COMPOSITION
AB.orthogonality: Must consume the exact materialized image produced by B and use the exact Split-K32 decomposition used by A; no AB-only optimization.

isolation_contract: Only the 14 exact Q4_K FFN-down nodes may differ among arms.
All Q6_K FFN-down nodes remain unchanged.
All Q/K/V/O, gate/up, attention, norms, embedding and LM-head nodes remain unchanged.
Workloads, model, decode length, token policy and runtime semantics are identical.
A cannot change representation; B cannot change work decomposition; AB cannot add a third mechanism.
No parameter/tile/subgroup search after fresh measured outcomes are exposed.

primary.acquisition: Calibrated Vulkan timestamps around the 14 Q4_K FFN-down dispatches; instrument identically in all four arms.
primary.per_attempt: For each of 31 decode steps, sum the 14 Q4-down dispatch durations; take the median of those 31 family sums.
primary.cell_summary: Median across 8 measured paired blocks per workload.

component_oracle.origin: Inherited from I002 proven transfer contract.

correctness.floating_hash_policy: Final hidden/logit hashes are recorded but not required bit-identical because Split-K changes FP32 accumulation order.
correctness.materialization_gate: For B/AB, independently reconstruct and hash logical Q4_K tuples for all 14 tensors; exact logical tuple equality with source tensors is mandatory before performance execution.

architecture_cost.materialization_time_ms: Measure one-time CPU wall time from source Q4_K bytes to complete RAM execution image, before inference.
architecture_cost.extra_ram_bytes: Exact additional resident bytes attributable to materialized Q4-down image.
architecture_cost.cpu_runtime_rule: No materialization or CPU model math may overlap measured decode.
break_even: N_B_vs_0 = Tmat_B / (L0 - LB) when LB < L0, else infinity/not-reached.
N_AB_vs_A = Tmat_AB / (LA - LAB) when LAB < LA, else infinity/not-reached.
Also report pairwise total-cost crossover N for every non-dominated arm pair.

timing_campaign.warmup: One unmeasured complete inference per arm/workload before measured blocks.
timing_campaign.balance_property: Each arm appears in each ordinal position exactly twice.

effect_decomposition.latency_symbols: L0, LA, LB, LAB are workload-specific cell latency estimates.

additive_ms.sign: Positive gain is better; positive G_INT means synergistic latency reduction.

effect_decomposition.uncertainty: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples over the 8 measured blocks, separately per workload; report 95% percentile CI for latency ratios and gain contrasts.
effect_decomposition.pooling: Workload-specific results are primary. Cross-workload geometric means are descriptive and may not override opposite workload directions.

A: device_read_over_weight may improve but is not required for H1-A support.
B: Component latency decreases if representation overhead is causally important.
Large ALU1/SBID improvement is not required; if stalls remain while traffic falls, representation and work-decomposition mechanisms are separable.
AB: If mechanisms compose, LAB is lower than both LA and LB.
Positive G_INT indicates synergy; CI containing zero is additive/no-detectable-interaction; negative G_INT indicates antagonism.
AB must not be credited for any optimization absent from A or B.

adjudication.correctness_first: Any arm failing correctness is scientifically failed; no speed result rescues it.
adjudication.A_supported: For both workloads, paired latency ratio A/0 has 95% CI upper bound < 1 AND ALU1 moves up while XVE stall and SBID move down at the counter probe.
adjudication.B_supported: For both workloads, paired latency ratio B/0 has 95% CI upper bound < 1 AND device_read_over_weight is lower than fresh arm 0.
adjudication.B_mechanism_only: If device_read_over_weight falls but latency support fails, classify representation mechanism observed but architecture benefit not established.
adjudication.composition_supported: For both workloads, AB is faster than both A and B with paired 95% CI upper bound < 1 for AB/A and AB/B.
adjudication.interaction_synergy: G_INT 95% CI lower bound > 0 in both workloads.
adjudication.additive_composition: Composition supported but G_INT CI includes 0.
adjudication.antagonistic_interaction: G_INT 95% CI upper bound < 0 in either workload.
adjudication.architecture_selection: Do not force a single winner. Remove strictly dominated arms using latency, materialization time and extra RAM; report non-dominated arms plus total-cost crossover token counts.
adjudication.no_arbitrary_horizon: No fixed expected-token horizon is assumed in this study.

m3b_priors_not_thresholds.note: These values motivate directional predictions only. Fresh arm 0 is the contemporaneous causal baseline; M3-B values are not pass/fail thresholds.

authorization.reason: Parent causal decomposition is frozen first. Child A/B representations and exact binaries/shaders must be independently locked before any measured execution.
